title: Yellow Citrusy American Steak Skewers
description: A citrusy and adventurous American dish featuring grilled steak skewers with a tangy chimichurri sauce, perfect for a Whole30-friendly dinner. The combination of citrus and herbs creates a unique flavor profile.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, orange juice, garlic, red pepper flakes, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped parsley and oregano to the bowl and stir to combine.
Thread the steak cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt and black pepper.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the steak reaches an internal temperature of 130 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the skewers are grilling, stir the chimichurri sauce ingredients together in a bowl.
Serve the grilled skewers with the chimichurri sauce spooned over the top.
Garnish with additional parsley and oregano, if desired.
